states.name: q_state
states.meaning: The 8-bit value stored in the D flip-flops, updated on the negative edge of clk.

rules.spec_quote: active high synchronous reset; The flip-flops must be reset to 0x34 rather than zero.
All DFFs should be triggered by the negative edge of clk.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: the negedge at which reset is sampled low; d is loaded on that same negedge

mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.

uncertain.note: R1 quote spans reset behavior and reset value; interpretation is that reset forces q to 0x34 on each negedge while reset==1.
candidates: reset forces q to 0x34 on each negedge while reset==1
reset forces q to 0x34 only on the first negedge after reset asserts
